research_question: Which large-cap U.S.-listed income stocks had the highest indicated dividend yields in late October 2026, and what supports or threatens each payout?

research_brief.purpose: Compare six large-cap high-yield income names using one pricing date and verified payouts, with the risk behind each yield.
research_brief.data_period: Payouts declared through October 22, 2026; prices are October 23, 2026 closes; results are Q2 2026.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Six selected large caps, not a full-market screen; yields are point-in-time Fin Loom calculations; no recommendation.

content_gaps: Ranking pages sort by yield without checking the latest declared payout at the company.
Few explain how structure (MLP, REIT, corporation) changes tax and coverage measures.
Few show how the same dividend produces different yields as the price moves.
value_add: Every payout checked against company releases, one pricing date for all yields, structure-specific coverage measures (AFFO, DCF, FCF), and a worked example of yield moving with price.
